basis: The page's own growth line reads 'Kythorn 1494: 15,910 -> Hammer 1495: ~16,400 -> Hammer 1496: 28,040'. The registry cell carried the Hammer 1496 state inside a Day-7 Hammer 1495 table. The boundary value is stated outright on the page, so it is applied, not flagged.

Every figure on the page is post-bridge Hammer 1496 canon (rolled 2026-06-12 via UDRP Strategic Overview; Date Operational says "1494 DR; current state Hammer 1496 DR"). The revenue line is the only one the page also stamps at Hammer 1495. The cost has no Hammer 1495 counterpart, so 9,800 is left standing and marked, rather than back-solved. The row is deliberately mixed-stamp and says so here.

Price found on the body: 320 gp/ton. The 48,400 cell is the 150 t/mo Eleint 1494 baseline; at the ruled 180 t/mo the body computes ~57,600. Not applied, because the registry row is an internally closed model - 48,400 revenue less 29,040 cost = 19,360 Baen net at 40% margin - and 14,520 of that cost is a Gauntlgrym smelting fee struck as a share of revenue. Moving revenue alone without the paired cost would fabricate 9,200 gp of margin. Scaling the cost is simulation, which is out of scope. Number recorded here; cell left internally consistent at its own stamp.

The 400 gp/dragon/month uniform model is superseded. 2,000 is plausible only for partial occupancy at ordinary tempo; full mixed occupancy is provisionally 2,500-3,500/mo. A range is not a cell value, and the occupancy state at Day 7 Hammer 1495 is not stated. Retained at 2,000 with the qualifier recorded.
